Multiple Food Recalls Issued Across US Retailers

Several major US retailers have issued recalls for various food products due to potential contamination. Publix supermarkets recalled blueberries and mixed berries, with some items identified as high-risk. Other recalled items include guacamole and granola bars. Consumers are advised to check product labels and return recalled items to stores for a refund. The recalls are part of a broader trend of food safety alerts this summer.
